pictures.author: Azim Khan Ronnie
pictures.observations: Whole960x640 aerial: round main roof with central gold bell/finial and eight surrounding smaller stupas. Broad teardrop-shaped paved terrace, rounded west end and long pointed end with dark stepped gold-edged square canopy. Blue/pale perimeter posts/rails, original abstract maze/radial paving vocabulary. Separate upper approach/stair walk exits opposite diagonal, through a gold gateway. Solar panels/forest/flags not copied; nearby context remains host content.

pictures.author: Najmul Islam
pictures.observations: Whole960x640 standing front: gilded round shrine/low columned arcade, maroon shafts/gold molded capitals and lobed ornamental heads. Main enclosed entrance has gold pilasters/nested frame and original triangular crest; dark closed grille. Round roof has maroon crest parapet/gold fascia, eight smaller bell/needle stupas around broad central gilded bell with ringed conical neck/stacked crown/open umbrella finial. Pale small umbrellas at ground level. Fine copied deity/inscription imagery and temporary scaffold omitted.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Buddha Dhatu Jadi standing hilltop shrine: round yellow/gilded enclosed hall with maroon/gold columned outer arcade, true recessed closed portal, lobed original arcade heads/entry crest, round gray roof/maroon-gold parapet. Broad central bell/ringed conical neck/crown/open umbrella finial and eight smaller surrounding stupas. Pictured teardrop paved terrace/blue-pale boundary posts, dark gold-edged pointed-end tiered canopy, simplified original seated figures/lotus seats/small umbrellas. Upper approach/gold gateway and mapped stair descent to the retained third stair control. Exact rooms, fine copied sculpture/inscriptions, forest/solar fixtures/visitor objects and remaining lower path are not authored.
